metadata.question: Did the land surface in Denmark appear more brown in July 24, 2018 compared to July 19, 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Denmark boundary from USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017.
- Dates: July 19, 2017 and July 24, 2018. Start with ±3 days; if empty, widen to ±10 days. Collections: Prefer Sentinel-2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR); fallback to Sentinel-2 L1C (COPERNICUS/S2); final fallback to Landsat 8/9 L2.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Yes, mask clouds: Sentinel-2 QA60 bits 10/11; Landsat L2 QA_PIXEL Cloud/Shadow/Cirrus. Exclude water using JRC Global Surface Water (occurrence <= 50). Compute NDVI and metrics on cloud-free land pixels.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after recovery: C1.
- If valid area after masking is 0: C2.
- If NDVI mean is null/NaN or outside [-1,1]: C3.
- Else compare fraction of low NDVI (<0.35) in 2018 vs 2017. If higher in 2018 => A; otherwise B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Denmark'))
      .geometry();

    const date2017 = '2017-07-19';
    const date2018 = '2018-07-24';

    // Land mask: exclude water using JRC Global Surface Water (occurrence > 50 is water)
    const gsw = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater').select('occurrence');
    const landMask = gsw.lt(50).rename('land');

    // Precompute total land area in ROI (m2)
    const totalAreaDict = ee.Image.pixelArea()
      .updateMask(landMask)
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      });
    const totalAreaM2 = await totalAreaDict.get('area').getInfo ? await ee.Dictionary(totalAreaDict).get('area').getInfo() : await totalAreaDict.getInfo();

    // Helper: Sentinel-2 masking to red/nir reflectance
    function s2ToRedNir(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0);
      const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0);
      const mask = cloud.and(cirrus);
      // Scale 10000 to 0-1 reflectance for both S2 SR and L1C
      return img.updateMask(mask).select(['B4', 'B8'], ['red', 'nir']).divide(10000);
    }

    // Helper: Landsat L2 to NDVI
    function lsToNdvi(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))      // cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0));     // cirrus
      const red = img.select('SR_B4').multiply(2.75e-05).add(-0.2);
      const nir = img.select('SR_B5').multiply(2.75e-05).add(-0.2);
      const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI');
      return ndvi.updateMask(mask).updateMask(nir.add(red).gt(0));
    }

    async function buildNdviComposite(dateStr) {
      const date = ee.Date(dateStr);

      async function tryS2(l2a, windowDays) {
        const collectionId = l2a ? 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR' : 'COPERNICUS/S2';
        const start = date.advance(-windowDays, 'day');
        const end = date.advance(windowDays + 1, 'day'); // end exclusive
        let col = ee.ImageCollection(collectionId)
          .filterBounds(roi)
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
        const n = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (n === 0) return null;
        const compRedNir = col.map(s2ToRedNir).median().clip(roi);
        const ndvi = compRedNir.normalizedDifference(['nir', 'red']).rename('NDVI')
          .updateMask(landMask);
        return { ndvi, nImages: n, src: l2a ? 'S2_L2A' : 'S2_L1C', windowDays };
      }

      async function tryLandsat(windowDays) {
        const start = date.advance(-windowDays, 'day');
        const end = date.advance(windowDays + 1, 'day');
        const col8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end);
        const col9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end);
        const col = col8.merge(col9);
        const n = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (n === 0) return null;
        const ndviMedian = col.map(lsToNdvi).median().rename('NDVI').updateMask(landMask).clip(roi);
        return { ndvi: ndviMedian, nImages: n, src: 'Landsat L2', windowDays };
      }

      // Try S2_L2A ±3d, ±10d, then S2_L1C ±3d, ±10d, then Landsat ±10d
      let result = await tryS2(true, 3);
      if (!result) result = await tryS2(true, 10);
      if (!result) result = await tryS2(false, 3);
      if (!result) result = await tryS2(false, 10);
      if (!result) result = await tryLandsat(10);
      return result; // may be null
    }

    async function metricsFor(dateStr) {
      const composite = await buildNdviComposite(dateStr);
      if (!composite) {
        return { status: 'C1' };
      }
      const ndvi = composite.ndvi;

      // Areas (m2)
      const validAreaDict = ee.Image.pixelArea()
        .updateMask(ndvi.mask())
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
        });
      const lowThresh = 0.35;
      const lowAreaDict = ee.Image.pixelArea()
        .updateMask(ndvi.lt(lowThresh))
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
        });
      const meanDict = ndvi.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      });

      const validAreaM2 = await ee.Dictionary(validAreaDict).get('area').getInfo();
      const lowAreaM2 = await ee.Dictionary(lowAreaDict).get('area').getInfo();
      const meanNdvi = await ee.Dictionary(meanDict).get('NDVI').getInfo();

      if (!validAreaM2 || validAreaM2 <= 0) {
        return { status: 'C2', src: composite.src, nImages: composite.nImages, windowDays: composite.windowDays };
      }
      if (meanNdvi === null || isNaN(meanNdvi) || meanNdvi < -1.0 || meanNdvi > 1.0) {
        return { status: 'C3', src: composite.src, nImages: composite.nImages, windowDays: composite.windowDays };
      }
      const validKm2 = validAreaM2 / 1e6;
      const totalKm2 = totalAreaM2 / 1e6;
      const lowPct = lowAreaM2 ? (lowAreaM2 / validAreaM2) : 0;
      const cloudPct = 1 - (validAreaM2 / totalAreaM2);

      return {
        status: 'OK',
        src: composite.src,
        nImages: composite.nImages,
        windowDays: composite.windowDays,
        validKm2,
        totalKm2,
        cloudPct,
        meanNdvi,
        lowPct,
      };
    }

    // Print ROI basic info
    const roiAreaKm2 = await ee.Number(roi.area()).divide(1e6).getInfo();
    console.log(`ROI: Denmark land area (~km²): ${(totalAreaM2/1e6).toFixed(1)}; scale: 1000 m`);

    // Compute metrics for both dates
    const m2017 = await metricsFor(date2017);
    const m2018 = await metricsFor(date2018);

    // Handle missing/invalid cases
    if (m2017.status === 'C1' || m2018.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('One or both dates: empty collection after recovery.');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (m2017.status === 'C2' || m2018.status === 'C2') {
      console.log('One or both dates: no valid pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (m2017.status === 'C3' || m2018.status === 'C3') {
      console.log('One or both dates: calculation failure (NaN/None).');
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence
    console.log(`2017 Source: ${m2017.src}; Images: ${m2017.nImages}; Window: ±${m2017.windowDays}d`);
    console.log(`2017 Valid km²: ${m2017.validKm2.toFixed(1)} / Total km²: ${m2017.totalKm2.toFixed(1)} (Cloud: ${(m2017.cloudPct*100).toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`2017 NDVI mean: ${m2017.meanNdvi.toFixed(3)}; Low<0.35: ${(m2017.lowPct*100).toFixed(1)}%`);

    console.log(`2018 Source: ${m2018.src}; Images: ${m2018.nImages}; Window: ±${m2018.windowDays}d`);
    console.log(`2018 Valid km²: ${m2018.validKm2.toFixed(1)} / Total km²: ${m2018.totalKm2.toFixed(1)} (Cloud: ${(m2018.cloudPct*100).toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`2018 NDVI mean: ${m2018.meanNdvi.toFixed(3)}; Low<0.35: ${(m2018.lowPct*100).toFixed(1)}%`);

    const deltaLowPct = (m2018.lowPct - m2017.lowPct) * 100;
    console.log(`Delta low% (2018 - 2017): ${deltaLowPct.toFixed(1)}%`);

    // Final decision: more brown in 2018 if low NDVI fraction higher
    if (deltaLowPct > 0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
